Getting started

Live in an afternoon, not a quarter.

Four steps from your first login to your first automated follow-up.

01

Connect your WhatsApp Business number

Sign in with Facebook and link your official number through Meta. Your customers keep messaging the number they already know.

02

Add your price list and FAQs

Getnera uses your own information to answer common questions, so replies sound like your business.

03

Invite your team

Everyone works from one shared inbox. Assign conversations and leads to the right person.

04

Follow up automatically

Send approved templates for confirmations and reminders to customers who opted in, on time, every time.
